value.rationale: The theorem classifies a motivated natural geometric asymptotic of the canonically normalized hollow symmetric Monge simplex, which has quadratically increasing vertex count but a geometrically distinguished small-corner hierarchy. It determines exact width scale, a non-Gaussian limiting law, all positive moments and the almost-sure localization of both exposed vertices. In particular the smallest vertex has nonvanishing limiting spherical angle while the metric face becomes angularly negligible. This provides structural geometric information not implied by the known normalized volumes or finite combinatorial simplex structure; no unproved practical application or elementary closed constant is claimed.
